text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

An all-male panel is worth noting as a governance weakness, but it can't plausibly explain *your* outcome: you are a man, the panel was men, and the man who won is a man. There's no mechanism by which sex disadvantaged you here. Raising it would likely read as grasping and undercut your credibility on the stronger points.

Those stronger points: on paper you out-qualify him academically (PhD vs. master's) and have eight years of documented section leadership against vague "broad leadership experience." That's where to push.

Also chase the written explanation — two weeks' silence is itself a process failure. Send a dated follow-up, in writing, citing your original request.
